title: Binary Tree Height
prompt:
Given the root of a binary tree made of TreeNode objects (val, left, right), return the number of nodes on the longest path from the root down to any leaf. An empty tree (root is None) has height 0, and a single node has height 1.

Example:
        3
       / \
      9   20
         /  \
        15   7
  tree_height(root) -> 3
